description: An agent-based, networked social-influence and policy-interaction model simulating face mask adoption, compliance, and sustainability under peer effects, information campaigns, retailer supply, and policy enforcement across heterogeneous locations.

modules.name: SocialNetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs and maintains the social network (small-world by default) and assigns neighbors to Person agents.

notes: Ensures connectedness by re-generating until largest component >= 0.95*N.

modules.name: PolicyCampaignModule
modules.description: Applies mandates, enforcement, subsidies, and periodic mask distribution. Produces a daily policy pressure signal.

update_rule.pseudocode:
mandate_active = (t >= mandate_start_day) and (t <= mandate_end_day)
policy_pressure = 0.0
if mandate_active:
  policy_pressure = enforcement_level
  for each location:
    location.mask_policy = 'required'
    location.enforcement_level = enforcement_level
    location.fine_amount = fine_amount
else:
  for each location:
    location.mask_policy = 'recommended'
    location.enforcement_level = default_location_enforcement_level
    location.fine_amount = location_fine_amount
# Subsidy broadcast
subsidy = subsidy_rate
# Distribution events
if (t % distribution_interval_days) == 0:
  target_agents = select_agents_by_rules(targeting_rules)
  for a in target_agents:
    a.mask_ownership += distribution_quantity_per_capita
emit signals with current policy state and any distribution events
notes: targeting_rules default to prioritize low SES and high exposure agents.
Distribution increases household and individual mask_inventory/ownership.

modules.name: InformationChannelModule
modules.description: Simulates media and information flow, producing daily media influence signals considering credibility, reach, and misinformation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
media_signal = 0
for channel in channels:
  effective_message = messaging_intensity * channel.credibility * channel.reach * (1 - channel.misinformation_rate) + (media_campaign_intensity * channel.credibility * channel.reach)
  effective_bias = channel.bias * channel.reach
  media_signal += effective_message - (misinformation_level * effective_bias)
# Normalize media_signal by number of channels
media_signal = media_signal / max(1, len(channels))
for each person p:
  exposure = clamp(Normal(info_exposure_mean, info_exposure_sd), 0, 1) * p.information_exposure_level
  person_media_influence[p] = media_influence_weight * exposure * media_signal
emit media influence by person and summary intensity
notes: Channels with higher bias and misinformation reduce net effective pro-mask signal.
Policy messaging_intensity is additive to media campaign intensity when mandates are active.

modules.name: MobilityAndLocationModule
modules.description: Generates daily schedules, assigns agents to locations, simulates contacts, and computes location-level compliance and enforcement actions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  draw today's schedule slots by daily probabilities (home, work, school, retail, other)
  assign p to a location for each slot respecting capacity
  observe local mask compliance in assigned locations; store observation fraction obs_f
# Contacts
for each location L:
  n = number of present agents
  expected_contacts = Poisson(max(0, contact_rate_per_location_mean + Normal(0, contact_rate_sd)))
  sample pairs up to expected_contacts from agents at L
  compute compliance rate at L: mean(mask_use_state)
  if L.mask_policy == 'required':
    for noncompliant agents:
      with prob L.enforcement_level * compliance_sensitivity, issue prompt/fine; record event
emit contacts, location compliance rates, and enforcement events
notes: Observation of compliance feeds back into behavior decisions via observation_effect_weight.
Capacity is enforced by random assignment with spillover to nearby locations.

modules.name: RetailerSupplyModule
modules.description: Manages retailer stocks, pricing, subsidies, and sales to agents and households.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each retailer R:
  R.stock_level += restock_rate_per_day
  desired_price = mask_cost * (1 + price_markup_mean + Normal(0, price_markup_sd))
  price_adjustment = price_adjustment_sensitivity * (1 - R.stock_level / max(1, initial_mask_supply/retailer_count))
  R.price = max(0.2, desired_price + price_adjustment - subsidy_rate*mask_cost)
# Sales
for each purchase intent (agent, qty):
  choose nearest retailer with stock
  transactable = min(qty, R.stock_level)
  if transactable > 0 and agent.budget >= transactable * R.price:
    execute transaction; update stock, agent.mask_ownership, household inventory; emit transaction
notes: Price adjusts upward when stock is scarce to model surge pricing; can be negative when stock is abundant.

modules.name: BehaviorDecisionModule
modules.description: Updates attitudes via peer/media/policy/observation, decides mask-wearing, and generates purchase intents.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  peer_compliance = mean(mask_use_state of neighbors) if neighbors else 0
  observation_signal = mean(observed location compliance) if any else 0
  # Attitude update (DeGroot + bounded confidence)
  delta_attitude = peer_influence_weight * p.social_influence_susceptibility * (peer_compliance - p.mask_attitude)
  + media_influence_weight * media_influence_by_person[p]
  + policy_influence_weight * signals.policy.enforcement_pressure
  + observation_effect_weight * (observation_signal - p.mask_attitude)
  p.mask_attitude = clamp(p.mask_attitude + delta_attitude, 0, 1)
  # Habit and abandonment
  if p.mask_use_state == 1:
    p.mask_attitude = clamp(p.mask_attitude + habit_formation_rate*(1 - p.mask_attitude), 0, 1)
  else:
    p.mask_attitude = clamp(p.mask_attitude - abandonment_rate*p.mask_attitude, 0, 1)
  # Utility-based decision
  utility = p.mask_attitude * risk_perception_weight * p.risk_perception + trust_weight * p.trust_in_authorities
  utility += peer_influence_weight * peer_compliance + policy_influence_weight * signals.policy.enforcement_pressure + observation_effect_weight * observation_signal
  cost = mask_discomfort_cost_mean + Normal(0, mask_discomfort_cost_sd)
  affordability = min(1, (p.income / 365.0) / max(0.1, expected_retail_price))
  purchase_need = 1 if p.mask_ownership <= 0 else 0
  decision_score = utility - cost + wealth_weight_on_purchase * affordability + adoption_noise * Normal(0,1)
  threshold = clamp(p.compliance_threshold + Normal(0, compliance_threshold_sd), 0, 1)
  if decision_score >= threshold and (p.mask_ownership > 0 or purchase_need == 1):
    new_state = 1
    if purchase_need == 1:
      emit purchase intent (qty = 5)
  else:
    new_state = 0
  if new_state != p.mask_use_state:
    emit adoption_event(p.id, from=p.mask_use_state, to=new_state)
  p.mask_use_state = new_state
notes: expected_retail_price is the previous day's average price; if unavailable, use mask_cost*(1+price_markup_mean).
Purchase quantity default=5 masks per transaction to buffer inventory.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Computes daily observables and summary statistics including adoption rate, churn, disparity, and location compliance.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean_over_agents(mask_use_state)
churn_rate = count(adoption_events where from=1 and to=0)/population_size
# Disparity: diff between top and bottom SES quintiles
adopt_high = mean(mask_use_state for SES in top quintile)
adopt_low = mean(mask_use_state for SES in bottom quintile)
adoption_disparity_index = adopt_high - adopt_low
location_compliance_rate = mean_over_locations(compliance_rate)
avg_price = mean_over_retailers(price)
emit all observables
notes: SES quintiles computed at initialization and stored per person.
Churn rate can be smoothed with a 7-day moving average in downstream analysis if needed.

algorithms.WattsStrogatz: Generates a small-world network with N nodes, each connected to k neighbors, rewired with probability beta.
algorithms.DeGrootOpinionUpdate: Iterative averaging of attitudes using neighbor states with bounded confidence via susceptibility.
algorithms.UtilityThresholdDecision: Compute utility minus costs plus noise; adopt if above compliance threshold; includes habit/abandonment dynamics.
algorithms.PoissonContactSampling: Sample number of contacts per location from Poisson with mean determined by contact_rate.
algorithms.ScarcityPricing: Adjust retailer price as a function of stock scarcity and subsidy.
